reviewNotes: Best overall compromise. At 100%, right tick20 reads fingertip contact; left has a small edge gap. At 120%, right ball is just above/at fingertips with a small residual gap; left appears on/near the hand. This is closer than candidate4 at 120% and avoids candidate3’s larger high gap. Frame9 uses the same contact vector as tick20. Frame10 remains the sole open-palm release.
limitations: A small residual separation remains at 120%, especially in the right facing; record this as a known native preview limitation.
